info.name: Solutech Backend API
info.description: Master Postman Collection untuk aplikasi Solutech Backend. Terorganisir dalam folder per modul (Authentication, Crypto Utilities, Products, Orders) lengkap dengan contoh respon status code resmi yang benar-benar ada di aplikasi.

exec: console.log('JWT Token successfully set to variable');

request.description: Request Login tunggal untuk autentikasi user. Token JWT otomatis tersimpan di variable jwt_token saat response HTTP 200 OK.

response.name: Example - 400 Bad Request (Validation Failed)
Example - 500 Internal Server Error (Database Connection Error)

item.name: Crypto Utilities
item.description: Modul helper untuk testing enkripsi dan dekripsi payload (Dev/UAT only)

request.description: Mengubah Plain JSON payload biasa menjadi format payload terenkripsi ({ encryptedKey, ciphertext, iv, authTag }) secara langsung.

response.name: Example - 500 Internal Server Error (RSA Key Error)

request.description: Mendekripsi payload terenkripsi ({ encryptedKey, ciphertext, iv, authTag }) kembali menjadi Plain JSON asli.

item.name: Products
item.description: Modul manajemen produk (CRUD, Pagination, Search, Soft Delete, & Role Permission)

request.description: Mendapatkan daftar produk aktif (isDeleted: false & deletedAt: null) dengan pagination dan pencarian. Bisa diakses oleh ADMIN dan USER.

response.name: Example - 200 OK (List Products Success)
response.body:
{
  "success": true,
  "statusCode": 200,
  "message": "Products retrieved successfully",
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "cmsj4pxbt0000qglwtaxg3rlk",
      "name": "Laptop ThinkPad X1 Carbon",
      "price": 22000000,
      "stock": 10,
      "description": "Business Ultrabook",
      "isDeleted": false,
      "createdAt": "2026-08-07T15:00:00.000Z",
      "updatedAt": "2026-08-07T15:00:00.000Z",
      "deletedAt": null
    }
  ],
  "pagination": {
    "total": 15,
    "page": 1,
    "limit": 10,
    "totalPages": 2
  }
}

item.name: Orders
item.description: Modul transaksi order (Create Order, Get List Orders, Get Order Detail)

request.description: Membuat transaksi order baru dalam 1 Database Transaction (prisma.$transaction) dengan pemotongan stok otomatis.

response.name: Example - 201 Created (Order Created Success)
Example - 400 Bad Request (Insufficient Stock)

request.description: Mendapatkan daftar order terpaginasi. Bagi USER biasa, HANYA menampilkan order miliknya sendiri (WHERE userId = currentUserId). Bagi ADMIN, menampilkan seluruh order sistem.
Mendapatkan detail transaksi order. USER biasa HANYA dapat melihat order miliknya sendiri (RBAC Ownership Check).

response.name: Example - 200 OK (Order Detail Success)
Example - 403 Forbidden (Forbidden: You do not have permission.)
